reason: A media-processing plugin that provides seven ffmpeg/ffprobe tools for probing, editing, concatenating, transcoding, subtitling, extracting media, and creating GIFs.

summaries.zh: 通过 ffmpeg 和 ffprobe 为智能体提供媒体探测、剪辑、拼接、转码、字幕烧录、素材提取和 GIF 制作工具。
summaries.en: Provides agents with ffmpeg and ffprobe tools for media inspection, cutting, concatenation, transcoding, subtitle burning, extraction, and GIF creation.

capabilities: Burns SRT or ASS subtitles into video
Extracts audio, frames, and subtitle streams
Invokes locally installed ffmpeg and ffprobe subprocesses
Reads input media and writes output files
